1092|fc807fb6.name: Captain Rugelfuss
1092|fc807fb6.text: At ease, $R.  This is no time for formalities.  With the Alliance forces under attack, the protection of the Dwarven territories becomes even more critical.  The recent Trogg uprising poses a dreadful threat to the King's land.

11081|cb7eee8e.name: Faldron
11081|cb7eee8e.text: Many animals lost their lives so that we could gain these materials. Do not take their sacrifice lightly, $N. Handle the leather with the respect it deserves.

1241|7991f640.name: Tognus Flintfire
1241|7991f640.text: Ye learn fast lass, much faster than I can keep up with. If ye want ta continue yer training, I suggest ye see my teacher. His name's Rotgath, Rotgath Stonebeard and ye'll find him in Ironforge at The Great Forge.

1355|0c543544.name: Cook Ghilm
1355|0c543544.text: Cooking is a life long pursuit and I see we share the same passion!

1572|04178a2e.name: Thorgrum Borrelson
1572|04178a2e.text: Mark my words!  You won't find faster gryphons anywhere in the Eastern Kingdoms than the ones right here in Thelsamar!

1573|10cfc531.name: Gryth Thurden
1573|10cfc531.text: The Wildhammer dwarves might have fast steeds, but can those Aerie Peak gryphons stand the heat of The Great Forge?  I think not!

1703|97c7cdfc.name: Uthrar Threx
1703|97c7cdfc.text: Hold on there, I'm just an assistant. If ye want to start learnin' the fancy stuff, talk to old Stonebrew over there.

252359|8fca8484.name: Lotheluum Starbreeze
252359|8fca8484.text: If you desire, in addition to training, I have it within my power to erase the knowledge of your talents from your mind.  Be warned that every time you undergo this procedure the more difficult it is to perform, and therefore the more expensive it becomes.

252477|404ff1f4.name: Peacekeeper Elite
252477|404ff1f4.text: That trainer can be found in the Crafter's Hall, on the west side of Valanaar.

257003|c65683ed.name: Ishlee Breezewhisper
257003|c65683ed.text: Winds tidings. What can I help you with?

269153|dab85bcc.name: Mountaineer Ylva
269153|dab85bcc.text: <The mountaineer clearly fought bravely before meeting her end at the weapons of the troggs.>

277|fe52f4ea.name: Roberto Pupellyverbos
277|fe52f4ea.text: Just browsing my wares or is there something specific I can help you find today?

2879|d56cf43b.name: Karrina Mekenda
2879|d56cf43b.text:
You can't teach an old dog new tricks.  At least that's what someone once told me.  Lucky for you, I've discovered it to be untrue.

However, pets do tend to get resistant to the technique, and I need more food each time to keep them happy.  What that means is that you'll owe me more money the more times I untrain the same pet.

Now then, would you like me to start untraining?

352|4946c28b.name: Dungar Longdrink
352|4946c28b.text: Where is it ye would like to go lad? For just a few coin my Gryphons can get ye there faster than even the swiftest horse.

4212|43a79d46.name: Telonis
4212|43a79d46.text: I regret to say that I cannot aid you, gentle lady, until you learn more of working with leather. Speak with Faldron or Darianna here instead. They can teach you the skill you require.

5150|942980f4.name: Nissa Firestone
5150|942980f4.text: Are you a student of the medical sciences?

5161|6aaffb9a.name: Grimnur Stonebrand
5161|6aaffb9a.text: Yap, I can teach ye to fish.

5171|86b6c1ef.name: Thistleheart
5171|86b6c1ef.text: The arcane only corrupts those who are weak. Keep up on your training, or you may find a similar fate.

5515|4a5716a3.name: Einris Brightspear
5515|4a5716a3.text: Look at the wisdom and knowledge of the beast, and you will see yourself. Observe as the owl does, learn cleverness from the sabercat, embody the mighty spirit of the wolf.

6790|c80041d2.name: Innkeeper Trelayne
6790|c80041d2.text: Welcome to my Inn, weary traveler. What can I do for you?

8965|bb0bc8e7.name: Shawn
8965|bb0bc8e7.text: Hello there ma'am... do you have a little time that you could help us out?  Please?

1002-progress.name: Unknown
1002-progress.text: Though you have yet to place the 6 Moonstalker Fangs inside, you believe you hear the sounds of static and incoherent gnome ramblings coming from within. Could someone else have fixed the machine already?
1002-progress.title: Buzzbox 323

1003-complete.name: Unknown
1003-complete.text:
"Sho yash gotsh the scalps in? That'sh sho great... Wha? Well, yesh I shuppose ya have realized that I can speaksh to ya without the materials in the machine. But I was telling the truth when I shaid they were broken!

See, in addition to being communimacation toolsh, the Buzzboxes also brew and distill fine liquor. Shorry for any deceptshion, but the nightelves do not apprecimerate my liquor trade in their townsh. I put shomething special in thish box to show my gratitude for yer effortsh. Enjoy!"
1003-complete.title: Buzzbox 525

1003-progress.name: Unknown
1003-progress.text:
You hear singing coming from Buzzbox 525.

"Though crawler wine's shweet, and thresher ale fine, and moonstalker moonshine ish grand. There's nothing sho dear, as a thistle bear beer, and shoon I shall have shome on hand!"

The hatch is open and awaits the 4 grizzled scalps as you hear the song repeated over and over.
1003-progress.title: Buzzbox 525

101-accept.name: Madame Eva
101-accept.text:
As the mystical taint creeps through the forest, the need for self-protection is undeniable, $N.  The winds whisper to me and they speak of a great danger which waits patiently for you in the near future.

If you wish to protect yourself, noble $c, bring to me 10 ghoul fangs, 10 skeleton fingers and 5 vials of spider venom.  For you I shall enchant a Totem of Infliction which will harm those who attempt violent acts against you.
101-accept.title: The Totem of Infliction

1138-complete.name: Gubber Blump
1138-complete.text:
Wow, these fine crab chunks are what I need.  Thanks $N!  I found this while I was fishing a while ago, and I have no use for it.  Maybe you can do something with it.  It sure don't make any good crab dishes.

I told you all about crabs, right?
1138-complete.title: Fruit of the Sea

1138-progress.name: Gubber Blump
1138-progress.text:
...lemon crab, whipper root crab, and Ironforge surprise crab.  That's about it.

Oh, hello there $N.  Do you have them fine crab chunks I was telling you about?
1138-progress.title: Fruit of the Sea

116-complete.name: Barkeep Daniels
116-complete.text:
A job well done, $N!  I know well the roads you had to journey to procure this fine array of liquor.  But my patrons will be happy once again! 

My wife is quite a seamstress.  Please accept this cloak she made in return for your services.
116-complete.title: Dry Times

116-progress.name: Barkeep Daniels
116-progress.text: I need you to pick up a keg of Thunderbrew Lager from Grimbooze Thunderbrew in the Westfall hills, a cask of Merlot from Stormwind, a bottle of Moonshine from Darkshire and a skin of Sweet Rum from Goldshire.  Bring those back to me and I will see to it you are rewarded.
116-progress.title: Dry Times

117-accept.name: Grimbooze Thunderbrew
117-accept.text:
Hurry, my friend, move with haste 
In order for our rich lager to taste 
More like beer and less like stew, 
Hops are needed to make the brew.
117-accept.title: Thunderbrew

117-complete.name: Grimbooze Thunderbrew
117-complete.text:
Hops and Barley, yeast and malt 
The taste-buds feel a virtual assault, 
No need to plead, no need to beg 
For Thunderbrew Lager comes in a keg!
117-complete.title: Thunderbrew

117-progress.name: Grimbooze Thunderbrew
117-progress.text:
Hurry, my friend, move with haste 
In order for our rich lager to taste
More like beer and less like stew,
Hops are needed to make the brew.
117-progress.title: Thunderbrew

118-progress.name: Smith Argus
118-progress.text: What's that?  Verner sent you, you say?  Well give me his note.  And SPEAK UP!
118-progress.title: The Price of Shoes

119-progress.name: Verner Osgood
119-progress.text: Great, you're back!  Did you get the shoes?
119-progress.title: Return to Verner

120-complete.name: General Marcus Jonathan
120-complete.text:
At ease, $c.

Magistrate Solomon is a noble leader.  His words carry great weight with me.  I shall seek the counsel of the King and make the situation clear to him.  Assure the good judge that he has the Stormwind Army's support.  Reinforcements will be sent as soon as word is given from His Majesty.
120-complete.title: Messenger to Stormwind

121-accept.name: General Marcus Jonathan
121-accept.text:
While I wait for a response from the King I want you to carry this letter to Magistrate Solomon. 

Dismissed, $c!
121-accept.title: Messenger to Stormwind

121-progress.name: Magistrate Solomon
121-progress.text: Did the General send news?  Are reinforcements on the way?
121-progress.title: Messenger to Stormwind

122-progress.name: Verner Osgood
122-progress.text: I know that greedy Argus will send someone to collect his scales if I don't give them to him soon.  Have you found those scales yet?
122-progress.title: Underbelly Scales

125-progress.name: Foreman Oslow
125-progress.text: Were you able to find my tools?
125-progress.title: The Lost Tools

127-complete.name: Dockmaster Baren
127-complete.text: Pleasure doin' business with you, matey!
127-complete.title: Selling Fish

127-progress.name: Dockmaster Baren
127-progress.text: You have some sunfish for me, eh?
127-progress.title: Selling Fish

129-progress.name: Guard Parker
129-progress.text: Darcy sent me a lunch, did she?  Such a kind heart she has.  Well...let's have it!
129-progress.title: A Free Lunch

131-progress.name: Darcy
131-progress.text: Hello again, $N.  Did Parker like the lunch I sent him?
131-progress.title: Delivering Daffodils

1338-complete.name: Furen Longbeard
1338-complete.text:
Ah, a request from one of the Stormpikes.  That's a proud clan, full of quality dwarves.  Rich ones, too.

Thank you, $N.  I'll get to work on Mountaineer Stormpike's shield by the end of the day.
1338-complete.title: Stormpike's Order

1338-progress.name: Furen Longbeard
1338-progress.text:
A letter from the dwarven lands?  I wonder who would call from so far to the north...

Please, let me see the order.
1338-progress.title: Stormpike's Order

143-progress.name: Gryan Stoutmantle
143-progress.text: Hail, $c.  What business do you have with The People's Militia?
143-progress.title: Messenger to Westfall

144-complete.name: Magistrate Solomon
144-complete.text:
I do say, this is not good at all.  I did not realize that Stoutmantle's situation was not unlike ours here in Lakeshire.  What action is so important that it calls the Stormwind Army away from its people?  Bah, I should not ponder aloud.

Here, messenger.  Accept these coins in exchange for your service to the Township.  I might call upon you again.
144-complete.title: Messenger to Westfall

144-progress.name: Magistrate Solomon
144-progress.text: Shall we expect the People's Militia soon?  Does Lord Stoutmantle's news bode well?
144-progress.title: Messenger to Westfall

145-complete.name: Lord Ello Ebonlocke
145-complete.text: Thank you for making the long journey here.  This is indeed important information.
145-complete.title: Messenger to Darkshire

145-progress.name: Lord Ello Ebonlocke
145-progress.text: You appear to have traveled from afar, $C.  What business do you have here in Darkshire?
145-progress.title: Messenger to Darkshire

146-accept.name: Lord Ello Ebonlocke
146-accept.text:
If I did not know Magistrate Solomon personally, I would say the man has gone mad.  Send the Night Watch to Lakeshire because Stormwind refuses aid?  The Night Watch was formed because Stormwind left us when this foul magic seeped into the land.  If I sent my Night Watch, this town would be overrun by evil before the guards even reached the forest's edge.

Take this letter of response to your Master in Lakeshire.
146-accept.title: Messenger to Darkshire

146-complete.name: Magistrate Solomon
146-complete.text:
By the Light!  The Stormwind Army retreated from Westfall.  And the Guard no longer protects Darkshire?  There is some treachery abound.  How could this be so? 

Oh I forgot to reward your service, $c.  Here are some coins.  Now excuse me.  Something is amiss in Stormwind and I must get to the bottom of it.
146-complete.title: Messenger to Darkshire

146-progress.name: Magistrate Solomon
146-progress.text: Ah, good to see you back, messenger.  Shall I inform the Marshal that the Night Watch is on its way from Darkshire?
146-progress.title: Messenger to Darkshire

148-accept.name: Abercrombie
148-accept.text:
Oh, what is a poor old man to do?  I need some supplies from Darkshire, but the village is so far away and I am so old and feeble...I would never make the trip.

Can you go to Darkshire and bring me back some Ghost Hair Thread?  You can get it from Madame Eva at her home on the Darkshire square.
148-accept.title: Supplies from Darkshire

148-complete.name: Madame Eva
148-complete.text: Ah, Ghost Hair Thread is what you need, is it?  I'm afraid I have none in stock, but I can make some for you...if you can supply the ghost hair.
148-complete.title: Supplies from Darkshire

149-accept.name: Madame Eva
149-accept.text:
There is a poor, sad spirit, Blind Mary, who haunts an old farm house in the hills south of Darkshire.

Here, take this Spectral Comb and ask Blind Mary to comb her hair.  Then bring back the comb and I will glean from it the Ghost Hair I'll need for the thread.

And take care, for dark things now lurk near that house...
149-accept.title: Ghost Hair Thread

150-progress.name: Dockmaster Baren
150-progress.text: Do you have those fins?  Hurry, we need those murlocs driven from the lake!
150-progress.title: Murloc Poachers

1618-progress.name: Verner Osgood
1618-progress.text: I hope you're here with good news from Ironforge.  Because I'm at my wit's end!
1618-progress.title: Gearing Redridge

164-complete.name: Sven Yorgen
164-complete.text: These supplies will be most useful. The aid of the Carevin family is always appreciated. Here is a little something for your trouble.
164-complete.title: Deliveries to Sven

164-progress.name: Sven Yorgen
164-progress.text: You look a sturdy type, $c. Have you come to join our fight?
164-progress.title: Deliveries to Sven

165-complete.name: Abercrombie
165-complete.text:
Elaine Carevin? Hehe, oh yes... of course, the Carevins.

No, nothing's wrong but it is hard for me to go into town now. The roads are dangerous and I'm not getting any younger. Maybe you can do an old man some favors?
165-complete.title: The Hermit

1681-progress.name: Tormus Deepforge
1681-progress.text: Have you entered Ironband's Compound?  Did you find the umbral ore?
1681-progress.title: Ironband's Compound

20-progress.name: Marshal Marris
20-progress.text: Have you been slaying orcs, $N?  If so, then show me...
20-progress.title: Blackrock Menace

2038-accept.name: Bingles Blastenheimer
2038-accept.text:
As if crashing into the Loch wasn't bad enough, troggs from the nearby island attacked me and stole my tools and special Blastenheimer Blastencapper explosives. With no gyrocopter and no explosives, the movement has no chance!

Get my tools back and find my Blastencapper explosives, $N. For Gnomeregan!
2038-accept.title: Bingles' Missing Supplies

2039-complete.name: Bingles Blastenheimer
2039-complete.text:
So Gnoarn doesn't trust my reconnaissance abilities? I wonder why...

Nevermind that, I need your assistance! Nay! The movement needs your assistance!
2039-complete.title: Find Bingles

2078-accept.name: Gelkak Gyromast
2078-accept.text:
Landlubber, ye needs to find me first mate.

Take this'n key, puts it in his gulliver an' bring him back here to serve the Cap'n.

Them murlocs an' their chief ain't gonna be too happy once me first mate gets a hold of em!
2078-accept.title: Gyromast's Revenge

2098-accept.name: Gelkak Gyromast
2098-accept.text:
A pirate's life ain't an easy one, landlubber. It ain't all about plunderin' and booze! Alas, me ship be sunk just off shore thanks to them pesky Threshadons.

What I be needin' is me first mate back in workin' order!

When I washed up'n shore, the key for me first mate broke on the rocks and was pilfered by the beasties of Darkshore. Out of the corner of me eyes I saw some of them Ragin' Crawlers, Ferocious Foreststrider, and murloc rummaging through the wreckage....
2098-accept.title: Gyromast's Retrieval

2098-complete.name: Gelkak Gyromast
2098-complete.text:
Avast ye scurvy sea dog! Ye did it! Soon me first mate be back in workin' order and them beasties won't know what hit em!

Hrm, have ye seen me first mate?
2098-complete.title: Gyromast's Retrieval

2098-progress.name: Gelkak Gyromast
2098-progress.text: Have ye found me broke down key, landlubber?
2098-progress.title: Gyromast's Retrieval

2139-accept.name: Tharnariun Treetender
2139-accept.text:
The survival of our people and lands comes at unfortunate costs, $N.

You have spilled the blood of nature's servants; many sick animals you have felled. The people of Auberdine are indebted to you, for the forest's pain is eased--even if only for a moment.

I have one final task for you, but be warned, you will have to kill again. It is my hope that this will be the last time I call upon you, $N.

In a cave to the northeast, near Bashal'Aran, resides the Den Mother. Slay her.
2139-accept.title: Tharnariun's Hope

2139-complete.name: Tharnariun Treetender
2139-complete.text:
You have fought for Auberdine with bravery and honor, $N. In our war torn lands, death and despair are common. Many will not rise to meet the challenge of life in our new home, choosing instead to hide in their homes or escape to the more fortified lands of the Alliance.

Thank you, $N. Perhaps someday soon we shall fight along side as comrades versus another foe.
2139-complete.title: Tharnariun's Hope

217-accept.name: Captain Rugelfuss
217-accept.text:
$N, our scouts have identified the leader of this recent Trogg incursion.  It appears that these beasts in Loch Modan are following the lead of a chieftain named Grawmug.  Grawmug is heavily guarded, however.  Two of his most elite guards, Gnasher and Brawler, never leave his side.

If you feel yourself worthy, $N, I want you to lead the assassination mission on Grawmug and his two thugs.  With the Trogg leadership dead, we just might stand a chance at pushing these beasts back into the ground.
217-accept.title: In Defense of the King's Lands

217-complete.name: Captain Rugelfuss
217-complete.text: Most excellent, $N!  You have brought hope to Loch Modan.  With Grawmug dead, we stand a better chance of seeing the Troggs eliminated from the land.
217-complete.title: In Defense of the King's Lands

224-complete.name: Mountaineer Cobbleflint
224-complete.text:
Well done, $N!  You demonstrated uncanny courage on the battlefield.  Our war against the Troggs will be won with efforts such as yours.  You have served King Magni well.

If you fancy yourself well-suited for this kind of adventuring, I suggest you speak with Mountaineer Gravelgaw.  The Captain has him assigned to a rough patrol that I am sure he can use some help with.  Check with Gravelgaw just inside the tower.
224-complete.title: In Defense of the King's Lands

226-accept.name: Lars
226-accept.text:
Sven and I have dangerous days ahead of us, what with the Necromancer to the east and all.  And out here alone as we are, we have to hunt for our own food.  It seems every time I'm heading back to camp with some meat on me, starving or rabid dire wolves come out of the forest wanting a bite.  It goes without saying, living out here is dangerous work!

But if you can rid us of some of those wolves, we'd have an easier time of it.  They mostly prowl north and east of here, near the river.
226-accept.title: Wolves at Our Heels

226-complete.name: Lars
226-complete.text:
Oh good.  You thinned out that pack quite a bit, and without those wolves nipping out our heels, we can bind our minds to dealing with Morbent Fel.

Here, take some of these Flash Bundles.  They make them in town, and a lot have been donated to Sven to help with his cause.
226-complete.title: Wolves at Our Heels

237-accept.name: Mountaineer Gravelgaw
237-accept.text:
Mountaineer Cobbleflint had nothing but good things to say about you, $r.  For that reason I am going to entrust upon you a mission of utmost importance.  We need to keep pressure on the invading Trogg forces until our Dwarven brethren return from the Alliance front.

Set forth into the southern hills and kill 10 Stonesplinter Skullthumpers and 10 Stonesplinter Seers.  Your attacks will buy us some time.  Report back when your mission is complete.
237-accept.title: In Defense of the King's Lands

237-complete.name: Mountaineer Gravelgaw
237-complete.text:
You accomplished your mission well, $r.  The King himself would be proud.

The reinforcements promised to us never showed, however.  Apparently the Alliance front is a sea of crimson from the blood of our fallen brethren.  The news of the losses leaves a bitter taste in one's mouth.  But we must not let their deaths go for naught.  We must rally in these grim times and bring glory back to the Alliance.

Speak with Mountaineer Wallbang for reassignment.  You're needed now more than ever.
237-complete.title: In Defense of the King's Lands

240-accept.name: Chef Grual
240-accept.text: And here we are - "Crab" Cakes ala Grual!
240-accept.title: Return to Jitters

240-complete.name: Jitters
240-complete.text:
Aha!  Thank you, $N.  Those really hit the spot!

And here, please let me pay you for these!
240-complete.title: Return to Jitters

240-progress.name: Jitters
240-progress.text: $N, you're here!  Do you have my food?!?
240-progress.title: Return to Jitters

245-accept.name: Watcher Dodds
245-accept.text:
Hail, $c. Perhaps you've seen those spiders that have taken over the western border? The eight-legged menaces are too much for us to handle, and the Commander hasn't enough manpower to spare so far from Darkshire.

I hate to ask this of you, but you seem like you might be able to handle them. I can't promise you anything of great value, but I can reward you if you can help root out the filthy bugs.

Oh, and a word of advice, you'll want to avoid their venom if you can.
245-accept.title: Eight-Legged Menaces

245-complete.name: Watcher Dodds
245-complete.text: Ah! You're back. And not too much worse for wear, it'd seem. Of course, $N, the Night Watch is grateful for your work, and I did promise you a reward, so here.
245-complete.title: Eight-Legged Menaces

255-accept.name: Magistrate Bluntnose
255-accept.text:
Two months just to hear from Ironforge that we'll be spared a handful of soldiers for our own defense, and another two months until they arrive! Bad enough that our town goes unprotected, but the excavation and the dam--the dam!--are open to attacks as well.

I've no choice then, it seems. I'll need hired arms.

How about you? You seem a likely sort, $c. A group of ogres has set up camp on the northeast of the lake. Perhaps you could recruit some others and help remove the threat to our town?
255-accept.title: Mercenaries

263-accept.name: Mountaineer Wallbang
263-accept.text:
The Mountaineers tell me you are quite brave and capable, $N.  We need a $r like you around here.  The Trogg problem isn't getting any better.  The reserves have been called to the front and we're all alone out here.  But now that we have a seasoned $c here, let's see what you can do.

Go out and kill 10 Stonesplinter Shaman and 10 Stonesplinter Bonesnappers.  Let's see if you live up to your reputation, Trogg-Slayer.
263-accept.title: In Defense of the King's Lands

263-complete.name: Mountaineer Wallbang
263-complete.text:
I knew the second I laid eyes on you, $N, that you would make Ironforge proud.  You have served King Magni well.  Now that you've proven yourself to be such a loyal aid to the Kingdom, perhaps you should talk with the Captain to see if he'll entrust you with a higher detail.

I salute you, $N.
263-complete.title: In Defense of the King's Lands

267-complete.name: Captain Rugelfuss
267-complete.text: I am quite impressed, $N.  You have done the Dwarven race a great favor by defending our lands.  King Magni Bronzebeard himself would be proud!
267-complete.title: The Trogg Threat

267-progress.name: Captain Rugelfuss
267-progress.text: Do you have 8 Trogg Stone Teeth to show me?  If not, there is still work to be done, $N.
267-progress.title: The Trogg Threat

287-complete.name: Senir Whitebeard
287-complete.text:
Ah, $N! I didn't think you'd have much trouble finding the place, my directions are excellent, you know...

Let me just finish up my report then.

<He brings out some paper and scribbles on it momentarily.>

There! Well, haha, now this certainly is funny... I don't suppose, $N, that you would mind doing one last favor for me?
287-complete.title: Frostmane Hold

291-accept.name: Senir Whitebeard
291-accept.text:
Excellent! Take my report to Senator Barin Redstone. He's a sour type, so don't let his less-than-sunny disposition get to you. He's in Ironforge, in the chamber where King Magni holds court.

Don't know the way to Ironforge? Take the road out of Kharanos north, cross the bridge, then follow the road east--there are large banners flanking the road--up the mountainside.

By the way, if you might avoid mentioning how you assisted me? Can't let them think I'm not working hard out here, you know?
291-accept.title: The Reports

297-accept.name: Magmar Fellhew
297-accept.text:
Recently, just before the Troggs surfaced within the site, we had uncovered a large number of strange, carved idols.  But we didn't have the chance to study them, for soon after their discovery the Troggs chased us away from the ruins!  And those idols have a strange effect on the Troggs.  It makes them go berserk!

Bring me 8 idols - I want to study them, and I want them out of Trogg hands!  You can find the idols on the Troggs infesting the site.
297-accept.title: Gathering Idols

298-accept.name: Prospector Ironband
298-accept.text:
I need a progress report sent to Thelsamar - a progress report, and a restatement of my request for more blastpowder!  Here's the report.  Take it to Jern Hornhelm.  He's our local contact in Thelsamar.

It's not a difficult task, but it must be done.
298-accept.title: Excavation Progress Report

298-complete.name: Jern Hornhelm
298-complete.text:
Bah!  Ironband's having trouble with the Troggs.  I wonder if he wants that blastpowder to aid his digging, or to aid his efforts against the Trogg beasts...

Well, either way it's powder well spent!

But what's strange is, I sent him plenty of blastpowder weeks ago.  I wonder where it went...
298-complete.title: Excavation Progress Report

298-progress.name: Jern Hornhelm
298-progress.text: Oh, a progress report from the site?  Very good!
298-progress.title: Excavation Progress Report

301-accept.name: Jern Hornhelm
301-accept.text:
We'll need approval to get Ironband more blastpowder. You'll have to take his report to the Explorers' League headquarters in Ironforge.

Here's the report. Give it to Prospector Stormpike, and don't forget to duck after you deliver it. Stormpike is hotheaded, and he won't be happy to hear of Ironband's slow progress at the site.

You'll find Stormpike in the Assembly of Explorers.
301-accept.title: Report to Ironforge

301-complete.name: Prospector Stormpike
301-complete.text:
Curse that Ironband!  I sent him a load of blastpowder weeks ago, but he's made no mention of it in this report.

So...where did the blastpowder go?!?
301-complete.title: Report to Ironforge

301-progress.name: Prospector Stormpike
301-progress.text: We Stormpikes don't like being bothered with trivial matters, $c.  I hope you brought news worthy of my valuable attention.
301-progress.title: Report to Ironforge

302-accept.name: Prospector Stormpike
302-accept.text:
If Ironband still needs blastpowder, then by Magni he'll have it!  I sent the approval on ahead with a messenger to Jern Hornhelm in Thelsamar.  He'll prepare the powder and other supplies to take to Ironband.

And one more thing: I want you to personally see that the shipment of powder reaches its destination.  The last one didn't, so keep your mind sharp and your eyes open.
302-accept.title: Powder to Ironband

307-progress.name: Mountaineer Stormpike
307-progress.text: Do you have that Miners' Gear, $N?
307-progress.title: Filthy Paws

3741-progress.name: Hilary
3741-progress.text: Hi.  I miss my necklace.  My daddy got it for me.  Daddy says that there are monsters in the lake.  Did you beat up any monsters?
3741-progress.title: Hilary's Necklace

413-progress.name: Mountaineer Barleybrew
413-progress.text:
Hello, $C!  And what business takes you all the way out here?

Something exciting, I hope.  I haven't been in a good fight in days, and this barrel of ale is almost dry...
413-progress.title: Shimmer Stout

416-progress.name: Mountaineer Kadrell
416-progress.text: Hail, $N.  How goes the rat catching?
416-progress.title: Rat Catching

417-progress.name: Pilot Hammerfoot
417-progress.text: Hello, $N.  Do you have word of my friend Hildelve?
417-progress.title: A Pilot's Revenge

418-progress.name: Vidra Hearthstove
418-progress.text: I'm all ready to start cooking, do you have the ingredients for me?
418-progress.title: Thelsamar Blood Sausages

436-complete.name: Magmar Fellhew
436-complete.text:
Jern wants to know what the slowdown is, eh?

Ironband is putting together his latest progress report with details, but I can tell you this:

It's the Troggs!!
436-complete.title: Ironband's Excavation

4722-progress.name: Gwennyth Bly'Leggonde
4722-progress.text: Hello $N - do you have any discoveries of creatures that have washed ashore to report on?
4722-progress.title: Beached Sea Turtle

4723-progress.name: Gwennyth Bly'Leggonde
4723-progress.text:
Perhaps one day we'll find a means to prevent these poor creatures from ending their lives needlessly on the coast of Darkshore.  Until then, we must continue our research!

Greetings $N - what news do you bring?
4723-progress.title: Beached Sea Creature

4725-progress.name: Gwennyth Bly'Leggonde
4725-progress.text:
It is a pleasure to see you again, $N.  We are making great strives in uncovering the mystery of why majestic sea creatures beach themselves on the Darkshore coastline, but with every question answered, two more are raised it seems.

Are you here to offer us more aid in our research?
4725-progress.title: Beached Sea Turtle

4727-accept.name: Unknown
4727-accept.text: The skeletal remains of a sea turtle lie in the sand of the northern Darkshore beaches.  The Greymist murlocs have either not found this carcass, or perhaps they have and are shying away from it for some unknown reason.  Regardless, there is enough of the turtle left to take a sample back to Gwennyth Bly'Leggonde in Auberdine for the Temple of the Moon to study.
4727-accept.title: Beached Sea Turtle

4727-complete.name: Gwennyth Bly'Leggonde
4727-complete.text: It is interesting that the murlocs were not present at this site; we will keep this in mind as we study this creature's remains!  Thank you for your effort, $N; the Temple of the Moon would like for me to give you this, as compensation for your time.
4727-complete.title: Beached Sea Turtle

4727-progress.name: Gwennyth Bly'Leggonde
4727-progress.text: Hello once again $N - have you found any more beached creatures that the Temple of the Moon should know about?
4727-progress.title: Beached Sea Turtle

4728-accept.name: Unknown
4728-accept.text: The corpse of what appears to be some sort of giant sea mammal lies partially gutted on the beach.  A wheelbarrow and various tools lie abandoned by this enormous beached sea creature, as though an attempt to study it had been made previously.  Though murlocs have scavenged this beast, enough of it remains to gather a suitable sample for Gwennyth Bly'Leggonde in Auberdine.
4728-accept.title: Beached Sea Creature

4728-complete.name: Gwennyth Bly'Leggonde
4728-complete.text: Ah, I believe you discovered one that was originally being examined by the Explorer's League.  They have a presence here in Darkshore, and they had mentioned that they were studying one of the beached creatures until they were chased out by the murlocs.  You appear to have succeeded where we both have not.  Please - accept this honorarium on behalf of the Temple of the Moon.
4728-complete.title: Beached Sea Creature

4728-progress.name: Gwennyth Bly'Leggonde
4728-progress.text: Greetings once again, $N!  What brings you back to Auberdine?  Are you here to report on another discovery, perhaps?
4728-progress.title: Beached Sea Creature

4730-accept.name: Unknown
4730-accept.text: The half-devoured corpse of what might have been a giant sea mammal lies on the beach.  A band of murlocs, stronger than those found closer to Auberdine, have taken up residence around the fallen creature.  Enough of the creature remains that a suitable sample of its bones could be delivered to Gwennyth Bly'Leggonde in Auberdine.
4730-accept.title: Beached Sea Creature

4730-complete.name: Gwennyth Bly'Leggonde
4730-complete.text:
The bones you have are from gentle sea mammals that are known to inhabit the waters surrounding the base of Teldrassil.  They had never been known to violently beach themselves like the threshers had been known to.  Why would these creatures do this, I wonder?  Well, perhaps the study of their remains will bear the fruits of knowledge that we seek.

Again, thank you for your aid.  Please accept this honorarium from the Temple of the Moon.
4730-complete.title: Beached Sea Creature

4730-progress.name: Gwennyth Bly'Leggonde
4730-progress.text: Hello again, $N!  Are you here to report on another discovery?
4730-progress.title: Beached Sea Creature

4731-accept.name: Unknown
4731-accept.text:
Another set of sea turtle remains lie beached on the coastline.  This set of remains has an abandoned carriage half buckled to the turtle's shell.  Perhaps this creature was driven to the shoreline by unknown beings rather than beaching itself as some of the other remains suggested.  Powerful Greymist murlocs have made the carcass of this creature their current home.

In the carriage, you find a box with strange markings on it; perhaps Gwennyth Bly'Leggonde in Auberdine can make sense of it.
4731-accept.title: Beached Sea Turtle

4731-complete.name: Gwennyth Bly'Leggonde
4731-complete.text:
I have heard of the kinds of carriages found on the back of that turtle.  Those I do believe are naga carriages, used both in battle and in transportation of their supplies on to land.  The markings on the box you found are of the naga; perhaps the creature you discovered was killed as it was heading further south... to Ashenvale maybe?

I will be sure to send this box to Darnassus with the rest of your discoveries.  This is for you - thank you again for your assistance.
4731-complete.title: Beached Sea Turtle

4731-progress.name: Gwennyth Bly'Leggonde
4731-progress.text: Hello again, $N.  The work you have done on behalf of the Temple of the Moon has been outstanding.  Are we to be blessed with more of your effort on our behalf?
4731-progress.title: Beached Sea Turtle

4732-accept.name: Unknown
4732-accept.text: You find a corpse of a sea turtle that had beached itself on the coast of Darkshore some time ago.  It has been picked nearly clean by Greymist murlocs, the very ones who now have encamped themselves around the creature's remains.  Still, there appear to be some suitable samples left on the creature's remains that Gwennyth Bly'Leggonde in Auberdine might be able to make use of.
4732-accept.title: Beached Sea Turtle

4732-complete.name: Gwennyth Bly'Leggonde
4732-complete.text:
You've found even more beached creatures, $N?  Sea turtles were commonly found frolicking along the base of Nordrassil before it was destroyed.  With the birth of Teldrassil, however, these creatures have been seen in ever decreasing numbers.  Some, as we have discovered, end their lives here for some unknown reason.

Your aid will perhaps unlock the mystery before us.  Please accept this in exchange for the remains you have provided for our study.
4732-complete.title: Beached Sea Turtle

4732-progress.name: Gwennyth Bly'Leggonde
4732-progress.text: Greetings once again $N - do you have any more discoveries to report to the Temple of the Moon?
4732-progress.title: Beached Sea Turtle

4733-accept.name: Unknown
4733-accept.text:
The remains of what appear to be a giant thresher have washed ashore on the rocky inlet of the Twilight Shore.  The thresher is several times larger than any of the other threshers spotted in these parts.  Wherever it came from, this creature would not seem to have been native to Darkshore.

Though the creature has been picked apart in places, enough of it remains to gather a suitable sample for Gwennyth Bly'Leggonde in Auberdine.
4733-accept.title: Beached Sea Creature

4733-complete.name: Gwennyth Bly'Leggonde
4733-complete.text:
The dimensions of the thresher you mention are mind-boggling.  Even the eldest of the threshers in this region grow to only a fraction of that size.  While some larger ones were known to be close to Teldrassil, their numbers have declined steadily.  I cannot help but wonder if these creatures beaching themselves here are somehow related to this.

While we analyze the bones you have brought us, please accept this on behalf of the Temple of the Moon.  Thank you, $N.
4733-complete.title: Beached Sea Creature

4733-progress.name: Gwennyth Bly'Leggonde
4733-progress.text: Thanks be to Elune - I am glad to see you again, dear $N.  The Temple of the Moon's work on the strange beaching phenomena continues here in Darkshore.  Might you have anything additional to offer us?
4733-progress.title: Beached Sea Creature

4762-progress.name: Thundris Windweaver
4762-progress.text: The pollution of the Cliffspring River is but the start of an alarming trend here in Darkshore.  The sample you provide will help us formalize a plan... a plan of attack, I am starting to suspect.
4762-progress.title: The Cliffspring River

4763-complete.name: Thundris Windweaver
4763-complete.text: We have just begun this war to reclaim our forest from the forces of corruption, but a battle this day has been won!  $N, the people of Auberdine owe you a debt of gratitude that will never be easily repaid.  Please accept this along with our thanks.  What we have learned here today may one day free our furbolg friends from the shackles of torment permanently.
4763-complete.title: The Blackwood Corrupted

4763-progress.name: Thundris Windweaver
4763-progress.text: The Talisman of Corruption is a sinister device that only serves to pervert the balance of nature.  When you obtain this item from whatever satyr is tormenting the furbolgs and bring it to me for disposal, we will have won a great victory this day!
4763-progress.title: The Blackwood Corrupted

4812-progress.name: Unknown
4812-progress.text: The crystal looks very alien against the wooded scenery of Darkshore.  You think you hear a very slight humming coming from deep within it.
4812-progress.title: As Water Cascades

5-accept.name: Jitters
5-accept.text:
I've been stuck hiding in this ghost town for weeks, and I haven't eaten anything but grubs and weeds!  I need some decent food, and I'm willing to trade well for it.

Bring me a feast and I'll pay you handsomely.

I heard Chef Grual at the Scarlet Raven Tavern in Darkshire makes very good Dusky Crab Cakes...
5-accept.title: Jitters' Growling Gut

5-complete.name: Chef Grual
5-complete.text: You need some Crab Cakes, do you?  Well I might be able to cook some up for you...
5-complete.title: Jitters' Growling Gut

6387-progress.name: Thorgrum Borrelson
6387-progress.text: Have you had your fill of Thelsamar so soon?  Are you ready to leave for another city?
6387-progress.title: Honor Students

6388-progress.name: Gryth Thurden
6388-progress.text: You look like you have somewhere to go.  Need one of my gryphons?
6388-progress.title: Gryth Thurden

6391-progress.name: Golnir Bouldertoe
6391-progress.text: What can I do for you, sir?
6391-progress.title: Ride to Ironforge

6392-progress.name: Brock Stoneseeker
6392-progress.text: Ah, $N.  Have you returned from Ironforge?
6392-progress.title: Return to Brock

86585-progress.name: Captain Rugelfuss
86585-progress.text: That banner looks like it's been in a war!
86585-progress.title: Banner of the Fallen

89-progress.name: Foreman Oslow
89-progress.text: This bridge isn't going to build itself!  Now where are those iron pikes and iron rivets?
89-progress.title: The Everstill Bridge

90-accept.name: Chef Grual
90-accept.text: Seasoned Wolf Kabobs are a house favorite!  Sure, I can make you some.  But first I'll need the supplies.  Bring me 10 Lean Wolf Flanks. Given the many wolves here in the forest, I am sure finding the Flanks will be no problem.  Fortunately for you, I just received my recent shipment of Stormwind Seasoning Herbs, so all I need are the flanks to get started.
90-accept.title: Seasoned Wolf Kabobs

90-complete.name: Chef Grual
90-complete.text: Very nice work, $N!  Enjoy the delicacy known as Seasoned Wolf Kabob!
90-complete.title: Seasoned Wolf Kabobs

90-progress.name: Chef Grual
90-progress.text: Were you able to find 10 Lean Wolf Flanks yet?
90-progress.title: Seasoned Wolf Kabobs

92-complete.name: Chef Breanna
92-complete.text: Well done, $N. Such fine specimens too! And here is your delicious delicacy known as Redridge Goulash!
92-complete.title: Redridge Goulash

92-progress.name: Chef Breanna
92-progress.text: I still need five pieces of Tough Condor Meat, five Great Goretusk Snouts and five helpings of Crisp Spider Meat.
92-progress.title: Redridge Goulash

92485-accept.name: Rorian the Dayseeker
92485-accept.text:
While you were away dealing with our vuldren problem, our resident $c trainer--Xyton Silverwind--left this note for you. Read it as soon as you can, and then seek out Silverwind on the ground floor of this great tree just behind me.

Heed his words and his counsel, he can teach you much.
92485-accept.title: A Student of Nature

92485-progress.name: Xyton Silverwind
92485-progress.text: Greetings, I am Xyton Silverwind, keeper of druidic lore.
92485-progress.title: A Student of Nature

92693-progress.name: Aamelia Windfield
92693-progress.text: There's not enough stormapples in skywall to repay you for this.
92693-progress.title: Standing Our Ground

92701-progress.name: Valennia Stormfist
92701-progress.text: A letter from Aonda. What's that crafty highlander been up to?
92701-progress.title: To Valanaar

92741-progress.name: Iaadaria Bitterwind
92741-progress.text: The High Order do not make it a habit to employ themselves as simple trappers and game wardens, but when performing a service such as this can lead to scholarly gain, we are happy to engage in acts of community service.
92741-progress.title: Unwelcome Visitors

92834-progress.name: Elaadrin Evengale
92834-progress.text: I don't agree with the Windshapers often, but they were right to dismiss the idea of trying to engage peacefully with the Al'Aketh. My attempt to take the high road cost a dear friend his life and is a mistake I will have to live with for the rest of my days.
92834-progress.title: Avenged Tenfold

92840-progress.name: Elaadrin Evengale
92840-progress.text:
It's often difficult for me to establish a distinction between the Windshapers and the Al'Aketh, save that one is more overtly violent than the other. Equally slavish to their misplaced beliefs, they are both equally dangerous if left to their own devices.

They see our desire to better understand this realm and its magic as a desecration of their traditions. Their small-mindedness is why our mission is so important. If not us, who will have the courage to save Zephras?
92840-progress.title: Catching Wind

92850-progress.name: Fillion Flamebreeze
92850-progress.text: Those shrieklings are too dangerous to be left to nest this close to Valanaar. However... they are the least of our troubles.
92850-progress.title: The Missing Scholar

93-accept.name: Chef Grual
93-accept.text:
I'll let you in on a little secret - Dusky "Crab" Cakes are really made from spider legs!  I know it's a bit disgusting, but the cakes have a nice, tangy flavor and make great snacks!  Bring me Gooey Spider Legs and I'll whip you up a few of them.

I hear Venom Web Spiders are a good source - they nest to the north, between the foothills and the river.
93-accept.title: Dusky Crab Cakes

93-complete.name: Chef Grual
93-complete.text:
Ah yes, a nice clutch of legs you have there!  Let me just get these seasoned with my secret spices (no looking!) and get them to skittering on a skillet for a while...

And, although Dusky Crab Cakes are my specialty and I won't give out the recipe, here's the recipe for a dish that's almost as good.
93-complete.title: Dusky Crab Cakes

93-progress.name: Chef Grual
93-progress.text: Hail, $N.  Did you get those Gooey Spider Legs yet?
93-progress.title: Dusky Crab Cakes

944-accept.name: Onu
944-accept.text:
It is strange that the naga are here, in Darkshore.  But stranger still...are the Twilight's Hammer.  That cult worships the old, old lords of the earth.  Lords defeated long ago.

The Master's Glaive, to the south, is a place where such an old lord fell.

Go there and look for more Twilight's Hammer cultists.

Take this phial of scrying.  Use it to create a scrying bowl after searching the Master's Glaive.  Then speak to me through the bowl.
944-accept.title: The Master's Glaive

944-complete.name: Unknown
944-complete.text:
The Twilight's Hammer is at the Master's Glaive?

Unfortunate.

The old lord impaled by the glaive is long dead, but that does not mean slivers of his power do not still remain.

The Twilight's Hammer must be seeking this power.
944-complete.title: The Master's Glaive

944-progress.name: Unknown
944-progress.text:
The Master's Glaive, $N.

Go there, then speak with me again.
944-progress.title: The Master's Glaive

94638-complete.name: Urs'endris
94638-complete.text:
The agony I feel over her loss is immeasurable, but it is what is necessary for the balance. You have demonstrated a resolve to persevere, even when a terrible price is asked.

You have done well, $c. I shall grant you the blessing to take on the shape of my kin. Be a beacon for those that lack the strength to persevere and a defender of those in need.

Go now, and embrace the way of the claw, child.
94638-complete.title: Strength and Mercy

947-progress.name: Barithras Moonshade
947-progress.text: Do you have my mushrooms, $N?  Have you been to the cave?
947-progress.title: Cave Mushrooms

948-complete.name: Onu
948-complete.text:
$N.  You are here.

Good.

We have matters...to discuss.  You and I.
948-complete.title: Onu

949-accept.name: Unknown
949-accept.text:
The Twilight's Hammer's purpose at the Master's Glaive is not known.  But it must be dark.

Search through their camp at the Glaive... Search for some thing that may teach us their intentions.

For we must learn their intentions before a plan is made.
949-accept.title: The Twilight Camp

949-complete.name: Unknown
949-complete.text: This book is hand printed in an ancient language, and illustrated by a master artist.
949-complete.title: The Twilight Camp

94912-accept.name: Alfina Nightgaze
94912-accept.text:
Greetings, young $c. 

Have you heard of the Cenarion Circle? I'd expect not. They are an ancient order of naturalists and practitioners of the druidic arts, much like yourself. In the city of Stormwind you'll find a night elf by the name of Sheldras Moontree. He will teach you how to reach the stronghold of the Cenarion Circle on Kalimdor, a place called Moonglade.

Go now. You have much to learn if you wish to save your home.
94912-accept.title: Child of Nature

94912-complete.name: Sheldras Moontree
94912-complete.text:
Greetings, fellow $c. It pleases me to meet a fellow $c from among the $R, and to be among the first to welcome you to Azeroth.

I think you will find that my fellow druids of the Cenarion Circle have much wisdom to impart upon you, child of nature.
94912-complete.title: Child of Nature

94914-accept.name: Sheldras Moontree
94914-accept.text:
All druids are welcomed to the sacred lands of Moonglade. Keeper Remulos--Moonglade's guardian--keeps watch over all druids who hibernate there. I'll teach you the spell that lets you transport yourself there. Cast it whenever you seek Moonglade's knowledge or solace.

As for your first lesson here on Azeroth, travel to Moonglade and speak with Dendrite Starblaze in Nighthaven about the path you're now on. Good luck, young $c.
94914-accept.title: Moonglade

94947-complete.name: Highlord Bolvar Fordragon
94947-complete.text:
Well met, $c. I am Bolvar Fordragon, regent to the throne of Stormwind.

A Kirin Tor messenger told me to expect to receive members of the High Order, and here you stand. It's been some time since a high elf has stood in this throne room, but I am glad to accept you now as a guest.

On behalf of the King, I welcome you to Stormwind and give you leave to travel freely through alliance lands. Welcome to Azeroth, $R.
94947-complete.title: Welcome to Azeroth

95-accept.name: Sven Yorgen
95-accept.text:
I used to work one of the farms to the southeast...until Dark Riders from Deadwind Pass descended upon my farm and slaughtered my family when I was away!

When I returned I saw a shadowy figure skulking near my barn, burying something.  He fled before I could catch him, and I couldn't linger for I was hot on the heels of the Dark Riders.  So I never discovered what was hidden.

If you can find what that shadowy figure buried, I would be grateful.  The hiding spot is behind the old stump near my barn.
95-accept.title: Sven's Revenge

950-accept.name: Unknown
950-accept.text:
Peering into the Twilight Tome is maddening.  Text begins to swim and dance after only a moment's glance, and once beautiful scrollwork twists into grotesque shapes.

Tearing away one page of insane scribbles is all that is possible before a swoon overtakes you.
950-accept.title: Return to Onu

950-complete.name: Onu
950-complete.text:
A chaotic, primal magic surrounds this parchment of scribbles.  I sense the work of the old ones in it.

Let us hope it reveals the purpose of the Twilight's Hammer in Darkshore...
950-complete.title: Return to Onu

95041-progress.name: Jemma Quikswitch
95041-progress.text: How is the data retrieval progressing?
95041-progress.title: Data Hoarders

951-accept.name: Onu
951-accept.text:
The parchment you found at the Master's Glaive is a page from an ancient text...written by elves!  It is heavily cursed and tainted by the corruption of the Twilight's Hammer, but it seems the cult is using ancient elven magic to bring their old masters back to our world.

Travel to the ruins of Mathystra to the northeast, and search for ancient relics among the grass and broken stones.  Through their study, we may divine how the Twilight's Hammer intends to exploit the magic of the elves.
951-accept.title: Mathystra Relics

96138-accept.name: Unknown
96138-accept.text:
A bow left by the spirit of Merrick Valor, famed Watcher who prided himself on keeping the roads safe from encroaching enemies.

With Merrick's spirit still wandering the roads, perhaps his unfinished business was to clear out invaders near his home in Raven Hill. The ogres south of town may be what's troubling his spirit.
96138-accept.title: Merrick's Bow

965-complete.name: Balthule Shadowstrike
965-complete.text: Elissa sent you? Then it is good tidings you bring. I have troubling news to report to her, and had no means with which to deliver it.
965-complete.title: The Tower of Althalaxx

966-accept.name: Balthule Shadowstrike
966-accept.text:
A group of warlocks has taken up residence around and inside the tower. I would have returned to Auberdine to report to Elissa earlier, but I was afraid that I might miss something while I was away.

Delgren suspected such a company might be gathering at the tower, but did not know why.

A few scraps of parchment that the warlocks carry have found their way to my hands, but I need more to complete the puzzle. I warn you not to venture into the tower, however, the warlocks there are much more powerful!
966-accept.title: The Tower of Althalaxx

966-complete.name: Balthule Shadowstrike
966-complete.text:
Many thanks, $N. This should shed some light on this warlocks' gathering...

Hmm... the Cult of the Dark Strand... I have never heard of this group before. Having no knowledge of their history, it is all but impossible to say what their plans must be.

There is no more time to delay. Warning must be delivered to Delgren immediately.
966-complete.title: The Tower of Althalaxx

966-progress.name: Balthule Shadowstrike
966-progress.text: Have you found any more of their scrolls? I should be able to piece together a larger picture of the cult if you can find them.
966-progress.title: The Tower of Althalaxx

967-accept.name: Balthule Shadowstrike
967-accept.text:
My master, Delgren the Purifier, is a paladin who has graciously offered his assistance in defending our forests from the forces of the demons and undead. He has taught me much about the Holy Light and the art of battle.

Delgren must know of the cult's operations immediately.

You will find him far south of here at Maestra's Post in Ashenvale Forest. Be swift, I fear the Dark Strand's threat grows with each passing hour.
967-accept.title: The Tower of Althalaxx

97914-progress.name: Baros Alexston
97914-progress.text:
I can smell the sea on you, friend!

<Baros laughs.>

What brings you to Stormwind?
97914-progress.title: Expanding Horizons

97926-progress.name: Thundris Windweaver
97926-progress.text: You have returned. What news comes from Stormwind?
97926-progress.title: Making Do

98042-accept.name: Delya
98042-accept.text:
<As you tear away the single page from the Twilight Tome, a foreboding voice floods your mind, uninvited.>

They have failed.

You will be forgotten.

They will lose the eye they gained.
98042-accept.title: It's All Fun and Games Until...

98042-progress.name: Thundris Windweaver
98042-progress.text: You look troubled. I am listening.
98042-progress.title: It's All Fun and Games Until...

982-progress.name: Gorbold Steelhand
982-progress.text: The captains of those ships were good night elves, and they deserve a better fate than they were given. Perhaps tending to their personal effects will be the best way to put their spirits to rest.
982-progress.title: Deep Ocean, Vast Sea

98247-progress.name: Marcy Baker
98247-progress.text: Ah, greetings! How can I be of assistance?
98247-progress.title: Shipping Label

990-accept.name: Sentinel Selarin
990-accept.text:
$N, my mistress, Raene Wolfrunner, awaits you in the city of Astranaar within Ashenvale. With your help, perhaps we can at least ease some of the corruption that's taken hold there.

Head south from here and stay close to the road--you'll find your way there without issue if you follow those directions.
990-accept.title: Trek to Ashenvale

99191-progress.name: Belanaa Windveil
99191-progress.text:
The High Order are currently accepting donations for wool cloth.

A donation of sixty pieces of wool cloth will net you full recognition by the High Order for your generous actions. Sixty pieces of wool should prove to be a sufficient amount for the High Order's needs for now. 

If you have the sixty pieces of wool cloth on you and are ready to donate them, I'm able to take them from you now.
99191-progress.title: A Donation of Wool
